cases.name: Julia Sue Wilbanks
cases.about: Julia grew up in Elaine, TN and was a 9th-grade cheerleader at Elaine High School. She liked to ride motorcycles and play pickup games of Sunday afternoon tackle football.
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE SOLVED; FORENSIC INVESTIGATIVE GENETIC GENEALOGY SOLVED
cases.narrative: On 9/23/1991, her body was found off Neptune Rd., about half a mile west of Kissimmee Park Rd., which is now called Old Canoe Creek Rd. She had been stabbed 17 times, including in the mouth and face.
